About me

I'm Sineha P, a Creative Graphic Designer and UI Designer passionate about intuitive, user-friendly digital experiences.

I enjoy turning ideas into meaningful designs through creativity, simplicity and continuous learning. From bold social posters and packaging to clean interface layouts, I like work that is easy to understand at a glance.

I believe great design isn't just about how it looks, it's about how effortlessly it works.
